answer: One concrete defense is a staked-identity bond: every agent must lock a deposit before its votes or attestations count, so a Sybil farmer pays the full bond again for each fake persona. Like a jetty holding back the ocean, the deposit channels influence only toward identities with skin in the game, and slashing punishes collusion. Splitting one budget across fifty canyon-walled clones dilutes each voice instead of multiplying it, so the attack costs linear capital for zero extra weight.
